audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart gave Rumble every row including Level 1 and 2+ items, contradicting the packet chart (Skill at Level 1, Volibear at 2+ items) and the page's own prose, which says Level 1 is even and that you flip the matchup with two items.
audit.why: Volibear at 49.74% over 386 games is an even lane that starts neutral and ends in his favour once Frenzied Maul scales off his health stacking.
audit.corrected: Row 0 = Skill, row 6 = Volibear; rows 1-5 stay Rumble.

audit.why: Spikes are right: Rumble at Danger Zone 3-5, Equalizer at 6, Liandry's first item; Volibear at two items where health stacking feeds Frenzied Maul.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every commit cue was keyed to Scrap Shield, treated as a rare answer to bait. Scrap Shield is a flat 6-second cooldown with no cost — it is essentially always available, so 'engage when it is down' is not an actionable window.
audit.why: Rumble's real vulnerability is Junkyard Titan: at 100% Heat he Overheats and cannot cast any spell. That, not Scrap Shield, is the window where Thundering Smash lands uncontested.
audit.corrected: Commit during Overheat. Flamespitter is 10/9/8/7/6s, The Equalizer 130/105/80s. Scrap Shield's derived knockup and terrain flags in the kit file are tooltip-parsing artifacts — it neither displaces nor creates terrain.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects: zero cooldown-sequencing lines anywhere in the matchup.
audit.why: Concrete numbers make the advice usable.
audit.corrected: Added Flamespitter rank-1 10s, Overheat 6s no-cast, Equalizer 130s to early, mid, cooldown breakdown and the don'ts.

audit.why: Riot's name is The Relentless Storm.
audit.corrected: Rewrote the line without the truncated name.

edits.before: Level 1-2 is a skill window before his heat comes online: Rumble wants to poke with Flamespitter (Q) while you stack Relentless Storm, so don't feed free harpoon-plus-Q poke early.
edits.after: Level 1-2 is a skill window before his heat comes online: Flamespitter is a 10s cooldown at rank 1, so walk up the moment it burns out and stack The Relentless Storm on him.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 are firmly Rumble's — a Danger-Zone Flamespitter zones the whole wave, Scrap Shield speed and Electro-Harpoon slows kite your Q charge, and his sustained burn out-damages your trades before your W executes.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 are firmly Rumble's — Danger-Zone Flamespitter zones the wave and Electro-Harpoon slows kite your Q charge. Your window is Overheat: bait two harpoons and a Q, then he cannot cast at all for 6 seconds.

edits.before: Track Rumble's Scrap Shield before you commit
edits.after: Punish the Overheat window, not Scrap Shield

edits.before: Bait it, then commit. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Scrap Shield returns every 6s; Overheat is the real gap.

edits.before: Rumble wastes Scrap Shield — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Merc's Treads plus Spirit Visage blunt Flamespitter's sustained burn.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: The Equalizer is a 130s cooldown at rank 1 — walk around the line or leap it.

edits.before: - Rumble Scrap Shield: matchup-defining — Bait it, then commit. Track it before every engage. - Rumble The Equalizer: A long line of fire that zones and chunks — his teamfight tool. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Rumble Overheat: 6s with no casts at all — that is your commit window, not Scrap Shield's 6s. - Rumble The Equalizer: 130s at rank 1, a fire line that zones — sidestep it or leap it with Stormbringer.

notes: champ-data/_kits/rumble.json gives Scrap Shield derived flags knockup and terrain. Both are wrong — it is a shield plus movement speed only. Mirror audit (rumble__volibear) flagged the same artifact. Do not let any downstream tool treat Scrap Shield as displacement.
